defaultTalks: Why, hello there, madam. I take it you've come to see about a retainer?

Well, I'm sorry to disappoint, but we're not in a position to introduce anyone to you at present. If you visit us again at a later date, we will of course do our utmost to accommodate your needs. Apologies again for the inconvenience.

defaultTalks: Yer one o' them adventurers, ain't ye? Gridania fair swarms with outsiders o' late. Can't walk ten bloody yalms without bumpin' into one o' ye.
Don't be takin' this the wrong way─we appreciate the hard work ye do, an' all─but 'tis hard to be at ease when scores o' strangers walk through yer home every day.

name.en: Who Was That Man in Black

defaultTalks: It is by the blessing of the elementals that we Gridanians dwell in the Twelveswood.
See to it that you do naught which brings our people to grief.

name.ja: エッグハントと黄金の宝物

name.en: Gone till the Sixth Astral Moon

defaultTalks: It is by the blessing of the elementals that we Gridanians dwell in the Twelveswood. As you go about your business, be ever mindful of their presence and respectful of their will.
This path leads to the Mun-Tuy Cellars, and through them the South Shroud.

1000136.ja: チョコボ屋 シングール

name.ja: 念願のマイチョコボ（双蛇党）

defaultTalks: You know who Mother Miounne is, sister? You'd do well to take her advice to heart.
There's some as say she's overbearing, but without her, we adventurers wouldn't be able to get by here in the Black Shroud. I myself owe her much and more.

name.ja: 新人木工師、チェミ・ジンジャル！
name.fr: Ça sent le sapin pour Beatin

defaultTalks: Memama never listens to me! I've told her countless times not to venture outside without her parents' permission, yet she never bothers to ask them.

name.ja: 新人木工師、チェミ・ジンジャル！
name.fr: Ça sent le sapin pour Beatin

defaultTalks: Pfarahr always treats me like a child. It fair drives me up the wall!
I recall the face of every adventurer who has passed my post.

But my duty extends beyond merely monitoring the movements of strangers. As a member of the Gods' Quiver, I am also charged with identifying those men and women possessed of potentially useful talent.

name.en: A Good Adventurer Is Hard to Find
name.de: Gute Abenteurer sind schwer zu finden

Les parrains de la fête des étoiles

defaultTalks: There is no such thing as an all-purpose wood. An archer's bow is quite unlike a scholar's bookshelf.
Different parts of the same tree can have different uses as well. Mind you, these are but the fundamentals of carpentry.
Continue down this path if you wish to enter Old Gridania.
There you shall find Atelier Fen-Yll─a gathering place for the finest leatherworkers in Eorzea. And should you seek somewhere pleasant to rest your feet, I recommend Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.

name.en: Who Was That Man in Black

defaultTalks: Mummy told me to wait here until she gets back.
The younglings at the Acorn Orchard have all had it rough.
I'm the grown-up around here, so it's my job to look after them.

name.en: Gone till the Sixth Astral Moon

Le roi est mort, vive le roi !

name.ja: 黒衣森で覚醒するもの

1000171.ja: フランシュモンティオ

name.de: Auf den Spuren des weißen Wolfes

defaultTalks: We Wood Wailers of the Seventh Spear are charged with maintaining the security of the eastern reaches of the North Shroud, as well as Hyrstmill and its environs. It is also our responsibility to ensure that the roads are passable and free of bandits.
Oh, and I almost forgot my most important duty: keeping a steady fire burning under our cookpot.

name.ja: 汚れた道しるべの清掃

defaultTalks: No thief's gonna get his grubby bloody hands on our grain while I'm on watch. Nay, not so much as a single mangy squirrel!
Nophica's Altar is a holy place. It is here that the Hearers communicate the will of the elementals to men.

The elementals govern all aspects of life in the Twelveswood, from the creatures we may hunt to the articles we may bring into their domain. As a result, foreign merchants dread visiting this place, conscious that their wares may be unwanted.

name.ja: 革細工師ギルドの危機

defaultTalks: Ahead you shall find Stillglade Fane, where the conjurers conduct their meditations. If you have business with them, you may proceed.
Bettin' all me earnin's on the auguries, I am. I cannae take another bad harvest.

name.ja: 森都を濡らす詐欺師の涙！
name.fr: La légende de Musosai : l'escroc de Gridania

defaultTalks: You stand before the Adders' Nest, the headquarters of the Order of the Twin Adder, Gridania's own Grand Company. It is here that our nation draws together its military, economic, and technological resources that we may bring their combined might to bear against our foes.

name.ja: いまだ戦火は途絶えず
新たな蛮族事件（双蛇党）
新たな蛮族事件（黒渦団）
新たな蛮族事件（不滅隊）

defaultTalks: Welcome to the Oak Atrium, headquarters of the Carpenters' Guild.
Perhaps you glimpsed the giant waterwheel on the path from the Blue Badger Gate? That would be Figaga's Gift, a triumph of engineering and the pride of our guild.
Have you perhaps heard mention of the Ixali tribe of beastmen? Long beaks? Sharp talons? They are a brutal race, preying on both man and beast with equal savagery.

It is not an exaggeration to call them our most bitter enemies. And now we have frequent reports of the birdmen seen not a stone's throw from the city walls. Have a care not to end up in one of their stew pots, stripling.

name.en: A Good Adventurer Is Hard to Find
name.de: Gute Abenteurer sind schwer zu finden

name.fr: Il va y avoir des spores !

レイ・アリアポーの弓術

defaultTalks: Only those of the Gods' Quiver are permitted past this point. I suggest you step away from the doors.

name.fr: Mon papa à moi est en concert

name.ja: 親子とチョコボの星芒祭

defaultTalks: Why the Archers' Guild, you ask? Hmmm... Perchance you are familiar with the popular saying about “keeping one's friends close,” and so on? Yes, well, I strongly disagree with its sentiments on enemies.
We're discussing how best to deal with the Ixali threat. Perhaps an adventurer such as you could offer a fresh perspective on the matter?
Love to 'elp you lass, but we ain't nowhere near ready.

1000215.ja: 防具屋 ドミシアン

1000216.ja: アクセサリ屋 イロリ

1000217.ja: 武具屋 ゲレイント

1000218.ja: 道具屋 アドミランダ

defaultTalks: The Calamity forced many a local merchant out of business. It was only when the Ul'dahns appeared that the markets began to regain a semblance of their former life.
Profits are high, but so is tension between locals and outsiders. While it can't be denied that the Ul'dahns have helped us greatly, their presence gives rise to new problems.
My brother Hadrefort and I oversee the Rosewood Stalls, while that Ul'dahn merchant Rishushu is responsible for the Ebony Stalls. 'Course, Master Parsemontret holds the real power in the markets.
Hadrefort thinks Rishushu is a decent enough lass, but I say that Ul'dahn wench can't be trusted. Aye, she's always dealt fairly with me, but it doesn't pay to ignore one's instincts in business...
Gridania's markets are divided into two main rows of stalls, named Ebony and Rosewood. Medicine and sundry goods can be had at the former, while arms and armor are found at the latter.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: Ahead lies Quiver's Hold, home to the Gods' Quiver, the defenders of Gridania. It also houses the Archers' Guild, if you seek training in the ways of the bow.

name.ja: リテイナーの冒険（森都）

1000236.ja: 素材屋 オ・ロヨド

defaultTalks: That godsdamned merchant from Ul'dah... I wish she'd bugger off back to where she came from!
I swear, every time she opens her mouth, it's about coin, coin, and more bloody coin!

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

1000238.ja: 雑貨屋 アラリック

1000239.ja: 薬屋 アルバガスト

name.fr: Bien mal acquis ne profite jamais

1000243.ja: 交易商人 リシュシュ
defaultTalks: I came all the way from Ul'dah to sell my wares, but the locals are proving an unreceptive lot.
Why, it's as if they're averse to novelty─to change and progress! I'm going to need a new approach if I'm to make any coin here...or perhaps an old one?

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: You are come to the Wailing Barracks, home of the Wood Wailers─the keepers of the peace within Gridania.
Visitors are welcome to observe the lancers in training. More than a few have been inspired to join after doing so.

name.ja: 馬とチョコボとイイ降神祭
name.de: Das beste Reittier weit und breit

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

1000251.ja: 槍術士ギルド受付 ジリアン

name.en: So You Want to Be a Lancer
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des maîtres d'hast

name.ja: いさおしき者たること

name.en: Sweet Dreams Are Made of Peace

defaultTalks: Down this path and across the lake lies the East Shroud.
You'll need to take the ferry if you have business in the Honey Yard or Nine Ivies.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

1000260.ja: オルトゥフェル牙兵長
defaultTalks: The Wood Wailers were wise to allow the Lancers' Guild the use of their facilities.
Training together can only lead to mutual improvement─and better qualified recruits for the Order of the Twin Adder.
The new recruits are quite promising. If they continue to hone their skills, who knows how strong they will become?
The Wailing Barracks lies beyond. If you have no business here, I would thank you to return whence you came.
When we must risk incurring the wrath of the elementals, we Wood Wailers and the archers of the Gods' Quiver wear these masks.

However, more than a few of us are beginning to think them naught but superstitious trinkets. I, for one, would be sorely troubled were it revealed that the guardians of the Twelveswood could be so easily deceived...
These gates are to remain closed until further notice. If you wish to venture outside the walls, you can ride the ferry from Westshore Pier south of the Lancers' Guild.

1000267.ja: 武具屋 レオポルド

defaultTalks: You... Could you possibly be...?
...N-No, forget I said anything. My mistake.

name.ja: ヴァレンティオンデーと苦い待ち人

defaultTalks: Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, so named for the legendary minstrel, once stood just beyond this rubble.

That all changed five years ago, when the Calamity laid it to waste. The amphitheatre has since been rebuilt at the center of our city, thanks to the tireless efforts of the carpenters of the Oak Atrium.
Walking one should not go any further down this path. Those ones who summoned the primal one will do hurtful things to walking ones who enter those ones' territory.

name.ja: 悪い子シルフの意趣返し
name.fr: Tel est pris qui croyait prendre

defaultTalks: The district beyond is home to distinguished Gridanians. Commoners may not enter. That includes you, adventurer.
Go back whence you came, or I will be forced to remind you of your place.
My wife and child... The men and women with whom I shared a stage... They're gone, every last one of them. There's nothing left in my life worth a damn.
Some five years ago, a great scholar stood vigil before these waters. It's said he came here to rally all of Eorzea in the fight against the Garlean Empire.
I do wonder what became of the man... I should like the chance to meet him in person.
You know why this place is called Apkallu Falls?
Someone once tried to breed apkallus here, or so the story goes. Looks like it didn't go too well, though...unless they're really good at hiding.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節
殺害予告？ 人気演奏家を護れ！

defaultTalks: I heard that the Order of the Twin Adder was officially reformed right here, in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. That was before the amphitheatre was moved, of course.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: Well do I remember the day the Order of the Twin Adder was reformed─the day I first laid eyes upon the Elder Seedseer.
Graceful yet strong, with a voice like song... When I close my eyes I can still see her standing there, clear as day.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節
殺害予告？ 人気演奏家を護れ！

name.fr: Qui veut voyager loin ménage sa parure

1000294.ja: 園芸師ギルド受付 レオンソ

name.en: So You Want to Be a Botanist
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des botanistes
Des plumes plus fortes que les épées

defaultTalks: Back off, will you? It's hot enough without you breathing down my neck.
What is today a tiny sprout may one day grow into a mighty oak and spread its seeds throughout the land.
It is no different with men. We are all equals in the circle of life, seeking only to survive.
We learn much by tending the gardens─not only about plants, but ourselves as well. As we help the plants to grow, so too do they help us.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

1000301.ja: 粉屋 リトルジョン

defaultTalks: Do you truly mean to cross the bridge and venture into Fallgourd Float? Far be it from me to dissuade you from your course, but have you spent a moment to think this through?
The creatures beyond this point will tear a novice adventurer limb from limb, then pick their teeth with the bones. Best stay close to the city gates and play with the squirrels and the ladybugs.
The path west of here is no place for fledgling explorers. “Vicious” does not begin to describe the monsters that dwell across the bridge.
Oh dear...I have kindled your curiosity, haven't I? Well, do not come running to me when some abomination bites you clean in half.
I-I'm fine. Nothing wrong at all, no need to concern yourself.
These gates lead outside the city. Take the road north if you seek Hyrstmill, and keep west if you're headed to Fallgourd Float.

name.ja: ツリースピーク厩舎の金具

defaultTalks: Ahead lie the Mun-Tuy Cellars. If you are traveling to the East Shroud, you may use the passage within.
Observe the brewers if you wish, but see that you do not interfere with their work.

Listen, adventurer, to the rustling leaves, the flowing rivers─to the very pulse of this land. We conjurers of Stillglade Fane interpret these whispers of the elementals and convey them to the people of Gridania.

Go quietly within these caverns.
...Lest you misunderstand, I speak not of such sounds as one's ears might hear.
Here we open our hearts to the whispers of the elementals. Take care that you do not disturb this communion by bringing in tumultuous thoughts.

1000323.ja: 幻術士ギルド受付 マデル

name.en: So You Want to Be a Conjurer
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des élémentalistes

defaultTalks: We've tried so many times to take it back, but those Redbelly whoresons are veteran killers.
Do you know how it feels? To see another man in your home, yet you're powerless to throw 'em out? For years!? Gods damn them all...
Refugees must first spend a night here in Quarrymill that the elementals might judge them worthy of living in the Twelveswood.
Their decision cannot be appealed. Every one of us, Gridanians included, dwell here only by the elementals' leave.

name.ja: 暗闇の底へと捧ぐ祈り

defaultTalks: They say Mun-Tuy brew is an essential ingredient in many Gridanian dishes. If you ask me, it's just an excuse to let the chef drink without arousing suspicion.
Believe it or not, these cellars once crawled with beasts. The Order of the Twin Adder came in and cleared them all out though, Twelve bless their hearts.
I tell you, I'd love to split a cask of Mun-Tuy brew with the Adders that put me back to work!

name.fr: Le secret de la sauce de Mun-Tuy

defaultTalks: Here we ferment the Mun-Tuy beans to make all sorts of wonderful, delicious products.
Oh how I love the smell of fermented beans! Shame my wife hates it─she won't touch me till I've bathed and washed my clothes.

name.fr: Le secret de la sauce de Mun-Tuy

1000352.ja: 革細工師ギルド受付 ランダル

name.en: So You Want to Be a Leatherworker
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des tanneurs

defaultTalks: Please be informed that Atelier Fen-Yll is not accepting orders for bristletail boots at present.
The hunting of bristletail marmots has been prohibited due to incessant poaching. As a result, we have been forced to cease production until further notice.
As the Twelveswood changes, so too must we change. To evolve and grow is the nature of life.
We endured the Calamity not by fearing the forest, but by following its example and adapting to survive.

name.en: In the Image of the Ancients

defaultTalks: It is seldom acknowledged, but leatherworkers shoulder a heavy responsibility─our raw materials come at the price of an animal's life, after all. Some of our crafters even give up the trade, unable to bear the guilt.
Of course, rather more of our crafters give up the trade because they are unable to bear our master's scorn...

1000363.ja: 革細工商人 ワービルグ
defaultTalks: Welcome to Fen-Yll Fineries! It would be my pleasure to serve you, milady...
...if you had an order placed, that is. We only deal in bespoke items, you see.
Lost your way, have you? This path here will take you to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and the Leatherworkers' Guild.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: There's coin to be had hunting bandits, I'll grant you that. But there're times when I long to do something more worthy of song.

name.ja: ツリースピーク厩舎の金具

defaultTalks: Gridanian food is as bland as it gets. I had heard the rumors, but gods, the water had more flavor!

name.ja: 革細工師ギルドの危機

defaultTalks: ...My father always said──“Masticate in moderation.”

name.ja: ツリースピーク厩舎の金具

name.en: Who Was That Man in Black

1000373.ja: スピニング・ブレイド
defaultTalks: I don't give two shites about how the food tastes. All I needs is drink.
I don't understand these Gridanians. They make a great show of doubting us adventurers, yet place their trust in beings they can't even see. Where is the reason in that, I ask you?

name.ja: 新人木工師、チェミ・ジンジャル！
name.fr: Ça sent le sapin pour Beatin

defaultTalks: I heard that the elementals show themselves when enraged. Call me reckless, but I'd love to see one in the flesh...or whatever the hells it is they're made of.

1000391.ja: 革細工師 オスギス

1000392.ja: 木工師 フェレオル

defaultTalks: The Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak lies within the jurisdiction of the Fifth Spear Wood Wailers. For safety reasons, access is strictly prohibited to all but those with express permission.

name.fr: Dans les mille gueules du loup

1000394.ja: 修理屋 アーケンボード

1000395.ja: 修理屋 クレマンタン

defaultTalks: Galfrid Mossback has led many good men into battle, and done his damndest to see them home safely.
He knows all too well what terrors the forest holds, and his determination to prepare our recruits to face them is expressed in his relentless approach to training.
Meals here at the Bannock are filling, but once in a while, it would be nice to have something with a dash of...well...flavor.
We once relied on the elementals to protect the Twelveswood, but with their power now diminished, it falls to us to shoulder this burden.
The Bannock was built for this very purpose. It is a tangible symbol of the commitment both the Elder Seedseer and the Order of the Twin Adder have made to maintaining the balance of the forest.

No matter how true their arrows fly, archers with eyes only for their targets have no place on the battlefield. One must always mind one's surroundings, and strike where and when the enemy at large will feel it most keenly.
Ommm......
Ommm......
Omm─ Ahem, if you don't mind, I am trying to meditate.
Before the Calamity made a mess of everything, there was a small village just north of here.
When the surviving villagers tried to return from Gridania, they found those Redbelly bastards living on their land. Bad enough to lose your loved ones, but then to lose what little's left...
None but authorized personnel may enter.

name.en: Who Was That Man in Black

defaultTalks: The Bannock is to the southeast of here. If it is Bentbranch Meadows you seek, cross the bridge and follow the road south.
Should you decide to venture over the bridge, be warned that the creatures in that neck of the woods are far more deadly in nature than the pests found in the shadow of the city walls.
This here's the Leatherworkers' Guild, renowned throughout Eorzea for producin' the best leather goods that gil can buy.

...If you're willin' to wait two years, that is. They've more orders than they can fill, see─which is why it's become necessary to maintain a Wailer presence here. Suffice to say, some customers ain't used to disappointment.
Like that prickly fellow over yonder. Wonder when he'll give up and go home...

name.en: I Am Millicent, Hear Me Roar

defaultTalks: If you travel to the west of here, you'll find Bentbranch Meadows and the Twin Adder training ground known as the Bannock. There are sure to be folks at either place who could do with a helping hand.

name.fr: Blessé dans sa chair... et son ego

defaultTalks: If you struggle to comprehend your purpose in life, merely strive to live well and all shall become plain in the fullness of time.
I hope you understand the risks involved with climbing the Matron's Lethe.
Even should you survive a fall, the beasts below will be quick to take notice. An adventurer like you should have no illusions about what would happen next.
The forest to the east is home to deathgazes and ziz, so don't go and cause a commotion unless you've no objections to being some beast's dinner.

name.en: In the Grim Darkness of the Forest

defaultTalks: Sylphs are, by and large, a bright and happy kind of folk, but those who have left their homeland behind have grown nervous and wary. I would ask that you do nothing to startle them.
Even a forestborn Gridanian must take care when abroad in the Twelveswood. I would not plan any romantic moonlit strolls through the trees if I were you.

name.fr: À la recherche du matériel perdu

defaultTalks: I got my first wood axe at the age of eight, an' I've never once looked back.
Can't say as I know much about aught else, but the loggin' trade's done alright by me.
You must beseech the elementals' consent if you would partake of the forest's bounty.
And only through the Hearers may the will of the elementals be known.

name.en: What Little Gods Are Made Of

defaultTalks: Good to see you out here, adventurer. The name's Gabineaux. I oversee the logging in these parts.
In return for the trees we take from the forest, it falls to us lumberjacks to tend to the saplings and keep the soil rich and vital.
All of which would be fine if it weren't for the damned monsters. My blood fair boils to think of the Twelveswood being defiled by foul beasts and parasites!

name.ja: エッグハントは新たな旅立ち

defaultTalks: Spirithold has been overrun by malicious imps. Have a care you do not fall prey to their subtle glamours.

name.ja: マイチョコボ育成の秘訣
ベントブランチ牧場への誘い
羊とチョコボと降神祭
エッグハントと黄金の宝物

name.ja: マイチョコボ育成の秘訣
マイチョコボ育成の秘訣

defaultTalks: Chocobos are as smart as they are sensitive. If you train them with love and care, they'll reward you with their undying loyalty.

name.ja: ようこそ、妖怪ミニオン

defaultTalks: Caring for chocobos is far more exhausting than it looks...
Bentbranch Meadows is connected by the Furline to Coerthas in the northwest, and by the Lumberline to Thanalan in the south.
When seen on a map, the place where the two roads meet resembles a bent branch─hence the name.

name.en: Where the Heart Is (The Lavender Beds)
name.ja: 花咲くラベンダーベッドの夢の家
name.fr: La maison de mes rêves à Lavandière

defaultTalks: Have you put a hand to our aetheryte yet? If you're planning on exploring the area, you'd be wise to attune yourself first.
Ye ever set foot on a ranch afore, stranger? Just mind ye don't rile up the chocobos, now.
To the west of here you'll find the Tam-Tara Deepcroft; to the east, the Mirror Planks.
Both fall under the Wood Wailers' jurisdiction, so be sure to comport yourself respectfully should you pay either site a visit.
Creatures have been attacking carriages en route from the South Shroud of late. See that you don't attract undue attention as well.

name.fr: Il faut laisser les morts dormir

defaultTalks: The Mirror Planks are not just for fishermen. Captains transporting their logs on the lake use the pier as well.
To truly thrive out here, one must learn to work with nature, not against it.
The bounty of the forest is a precious blessing, and we must not take more than can be replenished.
I know there are times when we have no choice but to turn to outsiders for help in dealing with our problems. To adventurers like you, for instance.
It's just that... <sigh> I wish I was brave enough or strong enough to protect the forest on my own.
We hold shipments here until their respective owners come and collect. Unless you have business to attend to, I cannot allow you to enter.
When the winds are calm, and the water still, you can see why they chose to call this lake the Mirror. The reflection is as true as any I have known.
<sigh> Why is my finishing touch always but a fingernail's breadth away from perfection?
I fear my mentor has lost all patience with me. At this rate, I shall never join the ranks of the Fen-Yll artisans.

You stand on the threshold of the city of Gridania. Here, your status as an adventurer counts for naught─a fact you would do well to remember. Be fairly warned, outsider: if you foment trouble within our walls, you will never leave them.
The lads and I are certainly glad of the Hawthornes and their hut. A sentry's work is tedious and tiring, so having a place where we can relax and let our guard down is truly invaluable.

name.fr: L'enfer est pavé de bonnes intentions

defaultTalks: Hearing the tales that Rolfe and visiting adventurers tell, I can't help wondering if I picked the right path in life.
Just once, it'd be grand to sail the seas on a proud galley, and spy the towers of a distant city glowing golden in the rays of the morning sun... Well, a man can dream, can't he?
Have you tried Rosa's mead? It's simply to die for! Well...perhaps not “die” as such, but I would certainly suffer a few stings for a mug. She and those honeybees of hers have a hit on their hands.

It was shortly after the spire sentries developed a taste for the stuff that word began to spread, then before we knew it, customers were turning up from as far afield as Limsa Lominsa! Still, men have traveled further for less!

Are the aetherytes not a glorious invention? I can only imagine how inconvenient it must have been for adventurers when the Calamity disrupted the aetherial flow and made instantaneous travel all but impossible.
The aetheryte here is relatively new, of course. And this wonderful tower was built to protect it.
It is called “Josselin's Spire” in honor of the captain of the first ever company of Wood Wailers. Fascinating, wouldn't you agree?
This area is teeming with dangerous creatures. We're doing our part to keep everyone safe, but you must needs take care of yourself as well.
Do take sufficient precautions when traversing the Twelveswood. This area has an abundance of belligerent beasts, and even experienced Adders have had to seek my care.
This one is weaving cloth. All the pretty cloth that walking one can see was made by these ones.
These ones keep the ways of weaving a secret. But even if this one taught walking one how to weave, this one doesn't think walking one could make cloth in the same way.

A word, if you will. The lands beyond this point belong to the sylphs. Unlike the gentle souls in Little Solace, the vicious woodland sprites out there will slaughter any outsider that dares cross their borders.
You're free to travel where you please, but know that none will come to your rescue should you stride blithely into the jaws of danger.

name.ja: 仮宿暮らしの困りごと

name.en: Bury Me Not on the Lone Prairie

name.ja: シルフ族と蛮神ラムウ

defaultTalks: Do not be alarmed. The sylphs here at Little Solace are of no mind to cause us harm.
The sylphs you should fear are the ones who dwell to the northeast, in the woodland tribe's homeland.
I am not privy to the details, but it appears some manner of quarrel has divided their people. I suggest you remain wary should you venture beyond the boundaries of this settlement.

name.ja: 仮宿暮らしの困りごと

defaultTalks: This one cannot follow walking one's words. This one begins to feel...sleepy...
But walking one speaks with much eagerness. So this one...will try to...stay awake...

name.ja: シルフ族と不思議な種
バスカロンドラザーズの掟

name.fr: La grande famille de la Poste mog

name.ja: いさおしき者たること

name.fr: Dans les mille gueules du loup

defaultTalks: They say Buscarron used to serve as a sentry at a lookout post north of here.
Why he chose to give up the soldier's life and become a tavernkeep is a deeper tale, but to cut a long story short, the local lads and lasses are glad he did.
I used to run with a gang o' bandits, me. Nasty, they was. Killers an' worse. 'Course, that was before Buscarron set me on the strait an' narrow.
Now the Druthers is like me second home─and I'd gladly gut any bandit who came in here lookin' to make trouble!

name.fr: Mieux vaut faire sauter que guérir

defaultTalks: Found yer way to Buscarron's Druthers, did ye? Ye wouldn't be the first to be drawn in by the scent o' quality grog.
Don't be afeared to drink yer fill, lass─them Redbelly thugs won't give ye no trouble in here.
Ho there, friend! Is this your first visit to the Druthers?
If so, then we drink to new acquaintances. If not, then we drink to old companions. A toast, I say, a toast to the best tavern in Eorzea!
The depths of the Twelveswood hold many dangers for the unwary. To the northwest lies the territory of the Ixal, whose borders even our soldiers are loath to cross.

Packs of bloodthirsty Ixal have been spotted not far from the city walls, and in the vicinity of several of the camps besides. You may think yourself a match for them─you may even be right─but I would advise you to exercise caution all the same.

name.ja: イクサル族斥候を排除せよ
name.fr: Voler dans les plumes des Ixali
Qui sème le vent récolte des plumes

1000615.ja: イサベル・ホウソーン
defaultTalks: Do you smell the honey? It may not compare to Mother's mead, but it's a lot nicer than the first batch I made. That one smelled like wet chocobo...
I can't talk to those sylphs. Yes, they scare me a little. Look, they aren't like you and me, you'd be talkin' to them and they'll just start...messin' with you.

name.ja: シルフ族と不思議な種

defaultTalks: If this is your first visit to Josselin's Spire, fear not─the tower is manned day and night by members of the Gods' Quiver and Wood Wailer units stationed here in Nine Ivies.
Welcome to Treespeak Stables. This is where most of Gridania's chocobos are broken in for riding prior to beginning their working lives as rental birds or Twin Adder mounts.
Chocobos are sensitive and timid creatures by nature, but they are more than capable of defending themselves if they must.

Why, just the other day I carelessly trod on a bird's toe, and received a nasty peck on the rear for my trouble. Thankfully my leathers prevented serious injury, but sitting is still rather painful...

If it's Hyrstmill you want, then head north. If you simply wish to stretch your legs, I'd suggest doing it somewhere safer. Take a leisurely stroll around those parts, and you're like to end up fodder for a slavering beast.

name.ja: 汚れた道しるべの清掃

defaultTalks: Have yer travels taken ye to Bentbranch Meadows out in the Central Shroud? They're part o' the Moogle's Gift family o' stables, just as we are.
If ye haven't already, ye might go and offer 'em a helpin' hand. I'm certain they'd have a use fer an adventurer who ain't afraid to muddy her boots.

name.ja: ツリースピーク厩舎の金具

defaultTalks: Welcome to Treespeak Stables. This is where we train the chocobos that were bred out at Bentbranch Meadows in the Central Shroud.

By all means have a look around, but I would ask you to refrain from entering the stables proper─the younger birds take fright easily enough without an unending procession of adventurers gaping at them.
Our main task here at Treespeak Stables is to train the chocobos, but we also grow greens for the birds and make our own fertilizer.
Well, I say we make it─the chocobos do the actual...making. Ahem. It's high-quality stuff, anyway. We receive orders from botanists as far afield as Hyrstmill and the city of Gridania.

name.ja: それは生温かく芳しく

defaultTalks: You are come to the hamlet of Hyrstmill. Lest you wonder, our outskirts are tightly patrolled to counter the Ixali threat.
I may add that those same patrols will not hesitate to deal with any who threaten the peace of our citizens. Do not imagine yourself above our laws.
Though we may soothe the suffering of our people, there is little we can do to dispel their fears.
When opposites collide, it is nature's way that the greater force prevails. Lend us your strength, adventurer, that we might overcome our enemies.
You need not fear the Ixal here. Hyrstmill lies under the protection of the elementals and the Elder Seedseer herself.
Caught a spear in the thigh once during a tussle with the birdmen. Aches like the seven hells when bad weather is on the way, but at least I know when to stay indoors!
No time to prattle! I've meals to prepare and a table to set before the workers come in from the fields!

name.ja:  よろしくハーストミル

defaultTalks: I once witnessed the Ixal tearing my friends to pieces, and my only thought was to flee in terror. Perhaps an adventurer is hardened to such sights...
But me? That sight will haunt me for the rest of my days...
What do you think of our waterwheel? It may not be as impressive as the grand wheels in Gridania, but it does give the place a certain charm.
The constant flow of the stream, the churning of the blades... Ah, like balm for the soul, it is.
Keep an eye out on your travels for odd feathers on the ground. Chances are the Ixal are not far away.
The birdmen often adorn themselves with feathered decorations, you see─seems the wretched creatures are trying to emulate the wings with which their ancestors were born.
This is where we store the Mun-Tuy beans. Hyrstmill is famous for them, you know.
We use every part of the bean, from the juice to the pulped husk. It would be the perfect food, if not for the horrendous smell...

name.fr: Un champignon ramassé, une vie conservée

defaultTalks: The waterwheel is the pride of Hyrstmill. Many here would gladly lay down their lives to defend it.
The guild's reputation for peerless craftsmanship is acknowledged even in Ul'dah.
Hence do the products of Fen-Yll Fineries command such high prices. And no right-thinking person with so much as an onze of taste would deny that they are worth every gil.
Why, I often visit Gridania just to look upon the exquisite quality of their work.

Damn those stubborn leatherworkers! I spent a fortune on this marmot pelt, but they refuse to use it in my order! Gods' sakes, the blasted creature's already dead! Surely, it'd be the greater crime not to make it into a pair of boots!
...Aye! 'Tis the perfect plan! If I can just get the trim right, these “genuine Fen-Yll fashions” will net me an Admiral's ransom back in Lims─
H-Hey, what's that look for? I'm simply considering a purchase for...my mum! Y-Yes, only the finest leathers for my dearest mum!
Do not judge the Twelveswood by what you see on the surface. With the presence of the elementals grown faint, the smallest patch of rot could spread to threaten the entire forest.
To prevent such a fate, we Hearers strain to catch even the slightest whisper of a troubled spirit.

name.fr: À la recherche du matériel perdu

defaultTalks: I was told playing with the younglings would make me a better carpenter. I...I don't think it's working.

name.ja: フェン・イルと革細工師

name.ja: ゲヴァパターンの真実

name.fr: Souple comme le cuir, solide comme l'acier

name.de: Wie die Mutter, so die Tochter

神聖遺跡 古アムダプール市街

defaultTalks: You are come to participate in the meditations, I presume?
Otherworldly voices have been waking me in the night, but I haven't the faintest idea why. I have done naught to incur the elementals' ire.

Ah, a new adventurer. I do so love meeting fledgling heroes─so young, so daring, so ambitious!
Tell me, have you made a will?

Not another step, adventurer. This path leads into the territory of such creatures as would swiftly deal a man his death. Only the most battle-hardened of heroes would have a hope of emerging from their midst unscathed.
None shall call you craven should you choose to walk away. Indeed, it takes true courage to recognize one's limitations.
Wander where you will, adventurer. But know that the forest will not suffer those who do not belong beneath its boughs to remain forever.

name.ja: ようこそ、妖怪ミニオン

defaultTalks: Never seen a chocobo up close before? Then have a care you don't stray too near and catch a friendly kick in the face.

name.fr: Mon papa à moi est en concert

defaultTalks: Do I not speak the common tongue with sufficient facility? How might I convince you to part with a single chocobo?
With the gil you earn selling one bird, you could raise three more. Really, do Gridanians have no understanding of simple economics?
Have you heard a word I've said, merchant? I would not trust you with a feather from one of my chicks' heads.
Do you honestly believe I would hand over the care of a chocobo to a soulless gil-grubber like you?
I but recently returned to Gridania to find the Twelveswood markedly recovered from the devastation left in the wake of the Calamity.
My heart stirs to see new life sprouting amidst the ruin, truly it does...yet I cannot help but remember the land as it once was...
This is Bentbranch Meadows, adventurer. If you've business at the ranch, then be quick about it. If not, then begone. I've work to do.
The creatures in these parts can be monstrous, but they are mewling babes compared to the nightmares found in Sorrel Haven. I would caution you against ranging too deeply into the forest.

name.en: In the Grim Darkness of the Forest

defaultTalks: The waterwheels make such a comforting sound. As long as I can hear them, I feel that everything is right with the world.
There are those born in Hyrstmill who find themselves unable to rest without the constant creak and trickle to lull them to sleep.

With Castrum Oriens to the south and the Sylphlands to the north, we must remain vigilant for any signs of aggression. Every sentry that patrols the East Shroud knows well that we are surrounded by enemies at all times.

name.ja: いさおしき者たること
それは生温かく芳しく

defaultTalks: Welcome to Fullflower Comb. As you may have deduced, we are in the business of raising honeybees.
And what industrious little creatures they are. Where would we be without their honey to sweeten our meals, and their wax to make the candles that brighten our nights?
Feast your eyes upon the Ebony and Rosewood Stalls─the two most bustling branches of Gridania's marketplace.

Ahhh, my soul soars to the sound of clinking coins and haggling peddlers once more! In the dark days after the Calamity, so many merchants gave up the trade that I feared my ears would never hear its like again.

name.fr: Il était une fois un explorateur

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

name.en: A Feast to Say the Least
 An Empty Sack Cannot Hang Downright

Ein Holz, den Drachen zu fangen

defaultTalks: We grow gysahl greens right here at the stables. If you want to raise healthy chocobos, it helps to have quality feed on hand.

name.ja: それは生温かく芳しく

defaultTalks:
We're closed. Come back later.
Would that every day could be a festival...

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: We conjurers are by no means all-powerful. It is only with the aid of others that we may begin to achieve our true potential.

name.ja: 馬とチョコボとイイ降神祭
name.de: Das beste Reittier weit und breit

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: Those conjurers are somethin', aren't they? Healin' the sick, and communin' with those “elementals” and such.
Truly amazin'. Ahem. Don't suppose you could tell me what an “elemental” is now, could you?

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節
エッグハントと黄金の宝物

defaultTalks: It is a sad fact that many who disrespect the ways of Gridania have not the slightest inkling that they have done so.

name.en: I Am Millicent, Hear Me Roar

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: Until five years ago, this amphitheatre stood in the northern part of the city. Then the Calamity struck and all but leveled the poor place. Thankfully, the Carpenters' Guild collected up the pieces, carried them over here, and rebuilt it just as it was before.
I cannot go a single day without looking it over, so afraid am I that some chip or stain has marred its perfection.

name.ja: ヘンシンと森都の守護天節

defaultTalks: Without the Fishermen's Guild, the pullers wouldn't have a place to gather and discuss issues like setting a wholesale price for fish or organizing repairs for waterfront facilities.

And since we started taking in foreign fisherfolk, the existence of the guild is especially important. Aside from teaching these outsiders the ways of Limsa's waters, we all get a chance to learn new tricks from one another.

name.en: All the Fish in the Sea
name.ja: 魅惑の「オーシャンフィッシング」

1000859.ja: 漁師ギルド受付 ン・ンムリカ

name.en: So You Want to Be a Fisher
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des pêcheurs

defaultTalks: Our guild 'as a fine collection o' live fish in the pool there. It's always squirmin' with the latest catch, ye see.
An' when the sea's been unkind with 'er bounty, I just drop a line in all sneaky-like an'─ Ahem, fine weather we're 'avin', ain't it?
Are you hoping to join our crew? You'll have to walk to the back of the line and wait your turn with these others. Perhaps the captain'll like your face; perhaps he'll pitch you over the wall.
There are many and more willing to risk his fickle favor for a chance to serve on Llymlaen's most beloved ship.
I'm the hired captain of the Orion. She's a fine vessel, true, but a hired captain can love his ship only as much as a paid bride can love her betrothed.
A ship of my own is all I've ever wanted. Was a gil away from buying one when the Calamity struck, but how can I complain when so many lost so much more?

1000890.ja: 鍛え抜かれた肉体の船乗り

1000895.ja: 巴術士ギルド受付 ムリー

name.en: So You Want to Be an Arcanist
name.fr: Premiers pas à la guilde des arcanistes

defaultTalks: All that would pass into Limsa Lominsa must first pass through Mealvaan's Gate. We levy excises and disallow contraband for the welfare of the market.
Trade can only be free when buyers possess the necessary assurances. Without the rule of law, the streets would be overrun by traffickers and cutthroats.

name.ja: 筆まめスウィートニクス
name.fr: De la timidité du marchand gobelin

defaultTalks: Being a customs officer often feels like a thankless job. On any given day, a dozen strangers will accuse you of high-sea robbery. I must constantly remind myself that what I do is for the good of the nation.

name.fr: La vengeance est un plat qui se mange froid

1000900.ja: とり澄ましている御婦人

name.ja: 巴術最大級命題の証明

name.en: An Egi by Any Other Name

defaultTalks: Please, not another word! If I am ever to become an official assessor, this training exercise must be the focus of my full and undivided attention!
All vessels that make use of Limsa Lominsa's ports must submit to a cargo inspection and pay the duties incurred. Please direct all inquiries and complaints to the front desk of Mealvaan's Gate.

name.ja: 海の都リムサ・ロミンサへ
ヴァレンティオンデーと甘い決闘
素材にこだわるレシピ
name.fr: Une faim en queue de poisson

defaultTalks: The Kraken's Arms reach far and wide, carryin' back spices to sell at the Seventh Sage.
Cap'n Carvallain watches over the business 'imself, when 'e's not busy watchin' over 'is crew.

name.ja: カボチャと海都の守護天節
素材にこだわるレシピ
name.fr: Une faim en queue de poisson

defaultTalks: And what brings ye to the Missin' Member, scrag? Think ye can just waltz in an' 'obnob with the Sanguine Sirens?
Well, if yer fool enough to try, so be it. Just watch yer tongue 'round Cap'n Rhoswen! Last man that didn't? Well, 'e's a member no more, if ye catch me drift.

name.ja: ヴァレンティオンデーと甘い決闘

defaultTalks: Cap'n Rhoswen's led the Sanguine Sirens to the top o' the food chain 'ere in Limsa. Ye want to join the meanest crew on the sea, then ye'd best bloody yer cutlass an' thicken yer 'ide.

1000926.ja: 斧術士ギルド受付 ブラウトータ

name.en: So You Want to Be a Marauder

À l'assaut de la Montagne vivante

name.en: Pride and Duty (Will Take You from the Mountain)

defaultTalks: The Yellowjackets used to be part of the Knights of the Barracuda, but we were swallowed into the Maelstrom during the Calamity.
Our voyage through the Maelstrom has hardened both our steel and our resolve.

name.ja: とっておきの人相がき

defaultTalks: This is the hive of the Yellowjackets, keepers of the peace in Limsa Lominsa.
We defend the commonfolk, and they serve as our eyes and ears in turn. Order is preserved under the mandate of the people.

name.ja: 案内係のお仕事～姉の場合～

defaultTalks: There's a whale of a tale behind the name of this place. Well, it's the tale of a whale, actually.
Bismarck devoured all that lay in his path, and the restaurant hopes its diners will follow suit.

defaultTalks: This is Bulwark Hall, the lowest level of the Mizzenmast. In case you aren't familiar with the nautical term, a bulwark is the plating that prevents waves from swamping a ship's decks.
Replace “waves” with “hordes of howling beastmen,” and you'll get an idea of the purpose for which this chamber exists.
Ah! Give a man a bloody fright, sneakin' up on me like that...
Hm? Newly come to Gridania, are ye? Then I suggest ye continue on yer merry way to the Carline Canopy just behind me. Mother Miounne will want a word with ye.
Another adventurer in search of work, are we? Ah, if you have but recently arrived in town, I must insist that you first register your presence with Miounne.
The number of visitors in Gridania is on the rise with every passing day. A pity their arrival seems to bring an equal share of trouble...
Make yourself known at the Carline Canopy, where the local Adventurers' Guild is headquartered. Speak to Mother Miounne within, and she will take you in hand.
So long as you are within Gridanian territory, you must abide by Gridanian laws. Go now, and do as I have instructed.
New in town, eh? You and me, we must be fond of the road indeed to brave the journey to this godsforsaken city.

defaultTalks: They say the Seventh Umbral Era is corrupting the wildlife in the woods─making the beasts stronger, more aggressive. I look forward to meeting them.
<crunch> Hm...? <crunch> Shouldn't you be speaking with...<crunch>...Mother Miounne? <crunch> <crunch> <crunch>
Bland cuisine apart, I have begun to grow fond of this city and its people.
The women, especially. I would not have believed the Black Shroud concealed such grace and beauty!

I thought a remote town like this would be the perfect place to turn a profit. But it seems that no matter where you go, success is invariably achieved through the usual combination of labor and luck. Hmph.
Gridania can be such a bore sometimes. All the people talk about is trees and elementals...

Perhaps I should try my fortune in a city with a touch more excitement. They say the streets of Ul'dah are paved with gold, and the pirates of Limsa Lominsa will slit your throat as soon as look at you!

Arrzaneth Ossuary is a sacred structure where mortals may seek the favor of Thal, arbiter of the afterlife...
...for in death, we must all abide by Thal's final evaluation of our existence. Those deemed to have led lives of richer virtue are rewarded...
...with greater comfort for their eternal souls. I urge you to consider making a donation and enhancing your virtue, thus ensuring a golden paradise for your time in the realm beyond...

defaultTalks: Master Mutamix was an inducted brother of the Illuminati, a goblin fraternity which has long been the marvel of the scholarly world. The knowledge they possess rivals even that of the Sharlayans.

Master Mutamix belonged to a fraternity of goblin scholars known as the Illuminati, but over time found himself at odds with their secretive ways. Believing that it is through dissemination that science evolves, he betrayed his own people, taking us under his wing to pass on the secrets of materia.

defaultTalks: Keep an eye on these tracks, an' sooner or later you'll see one of them magitek contraptions hauling a train of ore-filled wagons.
Do we got problems with thugs an' thieves making off with the shipments? Not while the Stone Torches are on the job.
This here operation takes the low-grade ore dug up in the Nanawa Mines and refines it.
Now don't you fret none about the quality o' the minerals. Everythin' is overseen by agents of Eshtaime's Lapidaries, and that means our purification techniques produce only the finest results.

name.en: Sometimes the Old Ways Are Best

defaultTalks: Looking for Black Brush Station? Well, you've found it. This is where the wagonloads of ore from the Nanawa Mines end up.
The raw materials are refined inside. With the furnace blazing away in there, the air becomes so stiflingly hot... I much prefer to wait on the shipments out here.

defaultTalks: Thirty-one, thirty-two, thirty-three... Hm? Bah, now my careful count has been compromised!

name.en: In the Court of the Rat King
Sometimes the Old Ways Are Best

defaultTalks: The Brass Blades have been keeping the trade routes safe in the Thanalan region since before the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era.

A veteran outfit like ours requires deep coffers to cover wages and upkeep, so it is fortunate that our employers include a number of Syndicate members. Keep that in mind, adventurer─this is no group of untested, two-gil rookies.

name.en: In the Court of the Rat King

defaultTalks: Even with wellsprings of water by the wayside, cultivating the dry domain of Thanalan was a daunting deed. Such an achievement could not have been attempted were it not blessed with the bounty of the sultana, and the boldness of our botanists.
But sustaining such a swath presents a plethora of persistent problems. Conundrums that only copious carts of coin can conquer.
Sultana Nanamo maintains these fields to provide provender for the poor. It is the wealthy, however, who end up purchasing our produce...
Welcome to the Coffer & Coffin! Be it belly-burning beverages or mouthwatering morsels, our refreshing repast shall renew your sagging spirits!

When ye spend every day with yer blade half-drawn and yer nerves strung up tighter than an Ul'dahn merchant's coinpurse, ye need a place where ye can sit down without somethin' tryin' to bite yer bleedin' arse off.

name.fr: Un autre nom surgi du passé

defaultTalks: They say they reopened operations in the Nanawa Mines to meet a voracious demand for raw materials─not surprising with all the rebuilding going on since the Calamity.
Me? I'm just glad the mines brought enough coin into the area to let Roger set up shop...and give me somewhere to stow my backside and drink while I avoid the unpleasantness of hard labor. Heh heh.
I've seen more than a few traveling merchants dragging their sorry hides through that door after crossing the wastes of Thanalan.
First thing they order is a cup of water─nothing tastes sweeter when your throat is choked with the dust of the road. It's not long until a mug of ale finds its way into their hands, though...
With all the traffic coming through Black Brush Station these days, I've had no shortage of customers. Enough extra business to indulge in a daily tankard or two of ale, anyroad.
The day the Calamity visited doom upon Eorzea, I expected nothing less than the end of existence. Yet Ul'dah once more bustles with business, as it did before.
And here we stand, serenely casting lines into the worry-free waters. Was that terrifying event naught more than a nightmare?

Those thrice-damned peddlers of Ul'dah would demand the entire contents of your purse for one maggot-filled loaf of bread. Thus, some adventuring colleagues and I decided to save our gil and set up a camp outside the city.
You share our profession, yes? If you should learn of any well-paying, low-risk jobs, we could certainly use the extra coin...

name.fr: Il était une fois un explorateur

defaultTalks: All clear to the right! All clear to the left! All clear of any potential problems until the shipment from Black Brush passes through, I should imagine.
I would slip away for a swift sip of spirits were my supervisors not possessed of such incredibly inconvenient timing for their inspections...

defaultTalks: The wagons from Black Brush have yet to veer into view. Ah, would that I could wander to the watering hole for a pint of precious pale ale.
I don't believe I've seen your face before. New to Gridania, I take it?
Then you're required to register at the Carline Canopy. Don't let me catch you strolling about until you've done so.

I had me another business once, same name as this one. Drove me to the brink of madness it did, when I lost me livelihood to the Calamity.
But I dug in me heels, worked hard, and built meself another Coffer & Coffin.
Wherever there are places populated with people, you shall perforce find peddlers. Merchants often meet in such areas that they might make a mutually beneficial exchange of information.
Despite havin' no decent soil, we've managed to grow some crops. The wee ones can enjoy a proper meal on occasion.

Is it just me, or are there more soldiers on the streets of late? Everywhere I go, I feel as though I'm being watched. It's downright unsettling, I tell you.

Since the victory feast, one consortium after another has been going under, and with nary any warning. Only the Syndicate has the power to do such a thing, but to what end? Could the rumors of revolution be true?

defaultTalks: My Ice Princess is the most graceful vessel ever to glide across the open seas. The waves can spin her round and round, but she'll never fall down.
If you're buying or selling, speak up. Otherwise, I've business to attend to. Next!

name.ja: 発令ギルドオーダー（ウルダハ）

defaultTalks: It's a pain in the arse checkin' every shipment out of Vesper Bay, but somebody's gotta do it. Otherwise, crates might start fallin' off the backs of the wagons, if you catch my drift.

name.ja: ギルドリーヴ開放「キャンプ・ドライボーン」

defaultTalks: Wait! Aren't you...? Ah, never mind. Carry on.
You know who Mother Miounne is, sister? You'd do well to take her advice to heart.
There's some as say she's overbearing, but without her, we adventurers wouldn't be able to get by here in the Black Shroud. I myself owe her much and more.
That's as far as you go, miss. Head on over to Bertennant, and mind you do as he says.

name.ja: エオルゼアの明日のために

name.fr: Chacun voit midi à sa porte

defaultTalks: Would it kill them to station me a few yalms closer to the action? Gods forbid I actually get to enjoy the tourney after all my hard work...

name.ja: 金色に染まるコロセウム

defaultTalks: Did you hear? My beloved Franz is fighting today! I can't wait to see him carve that overgrown oaf into bloody chunks!
As quartermaster of the Wood Wailers of the First Spear, I am responsible for the procurement and distribution of all supplies.
Should you have a talent for crafting or gathering, I would appreciate it if you could spare the time to complete one of our unit's guildleves.

1001881.ja: クリスタルブレイブの隊員

name.ja: タムタラの薄明るい底で

defaultTalks: Beyond lies the upper tier of Ul'dah, home to nobles and aristocrats alike. Know that here the eyes of the Sultansworn are upon you at all times.
We Sultansworn have vowed to put the safety of the sultana and her house before all else! But I sure could go for a sandwich...

1001939.ja: コージャル・スパイダー
defaultTalks: Ahem... Speaking of colors, though... The fountain and plaza below are known as the Gold Court. In former days, many a royal gala graced its stones.
Time was, the Sultansworn were the finest warriors in Ul'dah. But they've since grown as feeble and flaccid as the royal family itself.
<spit> Hells, they'll not even be a match for the Brass Blades before long.
<sigh> Just mentioning the treacherous heat causes fatigue... And my passion for alchemy is such that I oft forget to sleep.
And so I have resolved to concoct a magical elixir─a potable that shall imbue the imbiber with the energy of a bull, red with waking rage! Sleep, begone!
Beyond these doors lies Scholars' Walk, where you will find Frondale's Phrontistery and the Heart of the Sworn.
I realize what it looks like to the untrained eye. No more than making medicine, day in and day out, right? But what if I told you I mix dyes as well? No, I...I suppose that's just as boring.

name.ja: リテイナーの冒険（砂都）

defaultTalks: Welcome to Scorpion Crossing, friend. The finest waypoint in Thanalan, if I do say so myself.
Goods from Vesper Bay pass through here on the way to Ul'dah and elsewhere. Sadly, there are far too many crates to haul, and far too few hands to haul them.

name.en: Nor Rain nor Heat nor Gloom of Night

defaultTalks: Keep yer hands where me eyes can see, 'venturer. There'll be no thievin' in the Crossin' on me watch.
You're a good boy. Yes, you are. Oh, yes, you are! Who hauled that cargo all the way here? My good boy did. Oh, yes, he did! Here's some water and gysahl greens for my good boy.

name.ja: 豪奢なゴブレットビュートの夢の家
name.fr: La maison de mes rêves à La Coupe

defaultTalks: Kweeeh!
Cargo bound for the holds, check. Cargo bound for Ul'dah, check. Cargo bound for the camps, check. Cargo bound for... Gods, what I'd give for a vacation!

name.fr: Une lotion qui a du piquant
Une lueur d'espoir pour le Bazar

defaultTalks: The Wells are a blessing from Nophica Herself. So show some respect and dispose of your refuse elsewhere.
I think it's time I move on from this godsforsaken place. Haven't made a single bloody gil since I came.
Damn quiet for a port, ain't it? Hardly any ships making berth here no more.
Hells, when I was just out my mammy, time was you couldn't find a spot to piss off the docks, so many were the ships. Wouldn't think it to look now, would ya?
The fish aren't biting today. But there's always tomorrow. Aye, there're always tomorrows.

1002047.ja: スポッテッド・メドウ
defaultTalks: My associate and I want only to help rebuild and restore the Silver Bazaar to her former glory. Unfortunately, several of the local residents continue to refuse our generous offers to purchase their property.
There've been more and more people come to Ul'dah since the Calamity. The hammers are pounding the ground solid so as to make it fit for new homes for the rich.
I hear they're having trouble securing some tracts, though. Whoever's job that is, I don't envy them.
Finest imported wares, straight from the ship's hold to you! Not even in Ul'dah will you find such a wide selection!

name.ja: フフルパのマヌケな罠

defaultTalks: Well, it is what it is. But even if there's no work to be had here, there's always a place for a man with a strong back who knows how to swing a pickaxe!

name.ja: ナナシャマラカイトを取り戻せ！
name.fr: À la poursuite de la nashachite

1002062.ja: トリッド・ウィスパー
defaultTalks: Beasts, demons, Garleans─it's a pain in the bloody arse whatever it is! How's a man supposed to feed hisself?
They say the mines nearby have been overrun by wild beasts. All I know is it will be murder on my business if the miners stop showing up.
This never-ending procession of merchants will be the death of me. There must be an easier way to make an honest gil─say, fighting wild beasts in the Coliseum, or some such.

name.ja: フフルパのマヌケな罠

defaultTalks: What the hells am I to do with three crates of vanya silk gloves─all left-handed!? If I can't find a buyer by next moon, I'm ruined!
Can't ye see I'm on watch here? Now piss off 'fore I have ye locked up!

name.de: Raffe Raffzahn und die frischen Fische

defaultTalks: Some thaumaturge elite have been poking around the ruins. Waste of time if you ask me.
But to each his own, I suppose. So long as they don't get in the way of us doing real work!

name.de: Raffe Raffzahn und die frischen Fische

defaultTalks: Our cove is shaped as the moon when it first waxes and last wanes. It's from there our village takes the name Crescent Cove.
Times were good here...until the Calamity befell. Now the waters flow in ways they didn't, fish no longer are where they were, and hauls are too scarce to make it worth the while.

name.de: Raffe Raffzahn und die frischen Fische

defaultTalks: <sigh> What's the bleedin' point anymore? Anything I fish up, the bandits carry off! I'm better off just layin' down and dyin'.
Mendin' nets is the first work of any fishwife. The nets are always gettin' torn on rocks and coral, and pullin' up all manner of rubbish besides.
Please, ma'am, don't mind my brother. He doesn't mean what he says. He's touched, you see, and─
Oh, you're an adventurer. I thought you were one of the bandits. Gods forbid they hear the things my brother says about them.
Ah, the sea breezes of Limsa Lominsa are so refreshing. Quite a dramatic difference from the sultry winds of Ul'dah. Ah, but I must remain detached. Focused.
I am here, you see, to survey the extent of the Calamity's damage, but I often find myself overwhelmed by the unfamiliar sensations of this barbaric-yet-fascinating city.

name.fr: La vengeance est un plat qui se mange froid

name.ja: カボチャと海都の守護天節

1002086.en: 勝負を盛り上げる海賊
1002086.ja: 勝負を盛り上げる海賊
1002086.de: 勝負を盛り上げる海賊

1002086.zh: 勝負を盛り上げる海賊
1002086.tw: 勝負を盛り上げる海賊

defaultTalks: Well, I must admit that the variety of the catch found in Costa del Sol pales in comparison to the teeming fish markets of Limsa Lominsa.

And if one were to consider the dilemmas inherent in transporting freshly caught cargo from the city, it may prove wiser to employ a fisherman directly at the manor. Do you happen to know if the guild here is willing to hire out individuals talented with line and lure?
Why don't ye join me for a pint or two, lass? The grog's as cheap as water in this place! Even so, I reckon I've guzzled through half the sparklies I hoarded from me mercenary days, heh heh.
That damn Calamity, I tell ye. I lost me wife, me son, an' me daughter-in-law in the aftermath. If it weren't fer me grandson, I don't reckon I'd 'ave much reason to linger on.

Since I've been stationed here, I've learned more about ale than I thought possible. The folk here taught me that sailors stock barrels of the weaker stuff for long voyages, as even the freshest water will turn foul after a time.
And the stronger stuff? Well, that gets bought up by the merchants visiting Aleport. Lower taxes on our local brews, you see.

name.fr: À l'assaut de la Montagne vivante

defaultTalks: From here we stand watch over the La Thagran Eastroad, which joins Limsa Lominsa with the La Noscean lowlands.
La Thagran owes its name to the heroic helmsman of the legendary warship Galadion.

name.ja: コボルド族に気をつけろ！

defaultTalks: Up until about three years ago, we had crews working every ilm of these mines around the clock. The air was so thick with dust that half of them had to dig by feel. Blind iron mining, they called it. And so the name stuck.

1002229.ja: ウルスヴィルスト二等甲兵
defaultTalks: Ah, the Moraby Drydocks, the site of Naldiq & Vymelli's and the grandest shipyard in all of Limsa Lominsa─the perfect place to build the Maelstrom's newest warship.
We've doubled the guard around the Victory to keep an eye out for saboteurs and the like. If you want to keep your hide intact, I'd advise against any suspicious actions, adventurer.
Before the Calamity gouged out a ravine here, this used to be one long, unbroken peninsula.

'Course, seein' as the Moraby Drydocks are on the side opposite the city, construction on the bridge went forward soon as ye could blink. It ain't quite done yet, but the Embrace is sturdy enough for fully laden wagons to trundle across.
Think I got it easy here in the lumberyard? The builders haul off a good forest's worth o' planks each day, and it's my job to make sure every little splinter is properly accounted fer.
I'm sorry, dearie, but these lunches are for the shipwrights. Naldiq & Vymelli's hired me to make sure their lads and lasses are fed, and fed well.
The last thing you need is a hungry crafter fainting at the top of a mast and making a mess of the deck!

Cedar. That's what ye were wonderin', weren't it? Each kind o' wood has its own use, ye see. Now cedar, that's a tree what grows straight and tall, makin' it the perfect choice for masts and yardarms and the like.
We shipwrights ain't all the same, ye know. Carpenters, smitties, armorers─takes all sorts o' craftin' skills comin' together to shape a ship.
We do share one thing, though, and that's a Builder-blessed mastery in our chosen profession. Did you never wonder why a shipwright gets so much respect from the average, ale-swillin' Lominsan?

name.fr: Un phare qui brûle d'une flamme secrète
Sur le chantier de la gloire

defaultTalks: The rear entrance to the docks is just as heavily guarded as the front. After all, who knows what manner of strangers are among the craftsmen and couriers sailing in from Candlekeep Quay?
Greetings, and welcome to the main offices of Naldiq & Vymelli's.

If you are an artisan working here at the docks, I can assist you with a variety of matters, including employment contracts, labor assignments, wage payments, even lunch deliveries. You name it, I am at your service.

My days are consumed with the construction of the new ship, Victory. My colleagues and I must constantly remind each other to push forward with our work, lest we grow obsessed with attaining perfection in every blow of the chisel.
Have you spoken with Mimidoa out front? He holds a position at Naldiq & Vymelli's as an advisor now.
Most know him, however, for his incredible skills as a blacksmith. Yet, despite his achievements, he is always willing to lend a kindly ear to those around him.
She might be the boss, but Steelmaster H'naanza's work with the Armorers' Guild often takes her to Limsa Lominsa.
While she's away, the day-to-day runnin' of the docks falls to Ahtbyrm, Moraby's foremost shipwright.

1002269.ja: 乗船受付 オ・ノロシ

defaultTalks: The ferries that depart from Candlekeep Quay are the primary means of waterborne transportation between the island ports of Limsa Lominsa, Aleport, and the like.
These vessels do more than simply carry passengers from one destination to another─they also carry foodstuffs and other essential provisions to the shipwrights of the Moraby Drydocks.

defaultTalks: Copperbell Mines were first opened by royal decree during the Thorne Dynasty, over three hundred years ago. However, due to the Great Giant Revolt, the mines were sealed and abandoned for centuries.

The Concern purchased the mines from the royal family twenty years ago, but saw no need to resume operations until recently. Demand for ore rose sharply in the wake of the Calamity, and only fools would let developed mines go to waste─or so they thought.
Should've left it all buried and forgotten, if you ask me.

defaultTalks: In times of relative calm, the soldiers of House Durendaire expect to receive only the best equipment. But now that all of Whitebrim Front is preparing to retake the Stone Vigil, they have desperate need for materiel, as well as individuals like me who can procure it.
Welcome to the heart of Limsa Lominsa─the Mizzenmast!
It houses the airship landing, the Adventurers' Guild, and─at the very top─the command room of the Admiral, from where she keeps a watchful eye over Lominsan air, land, and sea.

name.ja: 案内係のお仕事～姉の場合～

defaultTalks: The Crow's Lift will carry you up and down the tower as fast as the crow flies.
You need only speak with Grehfarr and tell him where you wish to go!

name.ja: 案内係のお仕事～妹の場合～

defaultTalks: Rain, wind, or head-splittin' hailstorms, a candlekeep always keeps the torch shinin'. That's called a “sense o' responsibility,” missy. The thought o' bein' haunted by sailors what were dashed upon the rocks also helps a man remember his duty.

name.fr: Un phare qui brûle d'une flamme secrète

defaultTalks: Mealvaan's Gate assessors are not ordinarily stationed in Candlekeep Quay. There hasn't been a need since the port primarily deals in domestic cargo.
Look at that handsome wench. From here you can see her whole body, admire the perfection of her curves.
It'll be a glorious day indeed when we finally slip her into the water. Eh? I'm talking about the Victory, you gutter-dwellin' landlubber!
I remember when the Calamity sent a big ol' wave crashin' onto the coast o' Limsa. The Gods' Grip sheltered the docks from the worst of it, praise the Twelve.

Lot o' folks weren't so lucky, though. A whole flotilla of battered ships limped into the bay not long after─like a field hospital for sea vessels, it were. And now these days we're puttin' together the damn things from scratch. Bloody marvelous.
Don't look like much right now, but when I'm done poundin', stretchin', and shapin', these sheets of iron'll fit snug to the hull o' the ship. Just like a shinin' suit of armor.
As the sole entity responsible for the construction of Limsa Lominsa's seafaring vessels, it is only natural that Naldiq & Vymelli's would establish their main offices here at the Moraby Drydocks.
For a shipwright, there can be no greater honor or privilege than to work for such a prestigious company.
Welcome to Candlekeep Quay. Head within and speak with the skipper if you require passage to Aleport.
Used to be that only the candlekeep of Oschon's Torch made use of this port, but for a time after the Calamity struck, the Moraby Drydocks were unusable.
The facilities here had to be expanded to accommodate the flood of artisans and supplies needed for the restoration efforts.
The bulk of wool in Eorzea is shorn either here in La Noscea, or over in Coerthas.
La Noscean sheep are renowned for their soft white fleece, which is nothing like that coarse rubbish they peddle up in the highlands.

name.ja: ぼさぼさシープ虫除け法
ラノシア名産ふわふわウール

defaultTalks: Chocobos are such sensitive creatures. Without a steady stream of care and affection, they soon fall into the blackest depression.
Have you heard the tale behind the name of this quaint little place? It all started with the birth of a rooster, feathers as red as wine. Would that the story ended there...

See, the farmers laid wagers on this bird being stronger than the others, but the contest grew ugly. Blades were drawn, and both roosters and onlookers were splattered with scarlet shades of blood. Not so quaint now, eh?

name.ja: 潮香るミスト・ヴィレッジの夢の家
name.fr: La maison de mes rêves à Brumée

defaultTalks: The Red Rooster Stead boasts the greatest harvests of the biggest and best produce in La Noscea.
It needs to be picked and shipped cleanly and quickly so that it reaches market at its freshest. Anything less would be doing the growers an injustice.

name.fr: Rouler les galagos dans la farine

name.ja: コボルド族に気をつけろ！
ぼさぼさシープ虫除け法

defaultTalks: The Red Rooster Stead lies to the north of here, which is why we defend this highroad.
The barley and wool the Stead produces feed and clothe the people of Limsa Lominsa.

name.ja: 今度こそ海都で名をなす秘訣
ぼさぼさシープ虫除け法
ぼさぼさシープ虫除け法

name.ja: コボルド族に気をつけろ！

defaultTalks: Fifty years of farming have taught me the songs of the soil and the words of the wind.
Now the men come in from the sea and wish to hear them. It is good to know the knowledge will not die with me.
La Noscean oranges are chock-full of nutrients and are sweet-tasting to boot. They're vital to keeping scurvy at bay, too.
You'd think men who'd been away at sea would appreciate the value of fresh fruit, but these villains care only for coin.

name.ja: 真心仕込みのオレンジ
name.fr: Touche pas à mes petites bêtes

defaultTalks: Yon torches light the way to Seasong Grotto for souls lost at sea.
The verse engraved on its memorial was first found carved into the deck of a shipwreck, and has become a favored litany among Lominsan seafarers.
With the Maelstrom overwhelmed, it falls to the Yellowjackets to hold down the fortifications.
Maelstrom forces were spread thin in the first place, and that was before the Sahagin surge!

name.fr: Qui a volé, a volé le sac d'oranges

defaultTalks: Shovels? Ha! The only things that shed houses now are hungover freebooters.
Away from the orchards and out of the boss's sight─perfect spot for a nap.
The retired pirates are a restless bunch. All day they're at it─swearing and shouting and punching and kicking, wasting all that time and energy on everything but farming.
Merlwyb's forcing pirates to trade their swords for plowshares and start anew on land.
Far be it from me to question the Admiral, but how can a man who has spent his entire life reaping be taught to sow?
No work ethic in these washed-up lackeys! Too busy living in the past to make a difference in the present.
I'd hoped they'd put that pirate muscle to good use out in the fields, but I failed to reckon on their loafing pirate bones.

name.fr: Qui a volé, a volé le sac d'oranges
Qui a volé, a volé le sac d'oranges

defaultTalks: Eorzea spans far and wide, but nowhere will you find so many windmills as here!
Harnessing the winds that blow in from the sea to grind grain and felt fleece─is it no less than sorcery?

name.ja: ラノシア名産ふわふわウール

name.fr: Rouler les galagos dans la farine

defaultTalks: While the mill turns in perpetuity, our toils are tied to the ebb and flow of the Stead.
During harvests and shearings, we rarely catch a wink.

name.ja: コボルド族に気をつけろ！

defaultTalks: A miller takes special pride in his mill, and I couldn't be prouder of this one.
These mills are built from the dead works and dunnage of decommissioned ships, the cloth taken from masts of the armada.
Though they may no longer ride the waves, the old ship bones still remain a fleet.
The “Grey” in “the Grey Fleet” owes to the mills' ability to withstand even the grimmest of storms.

As anyone who's ever raised livestock will tell you, animals feel and show emotions as deep and real as yours or mine. One need only look for the telltale signs: a fetching pose, a come-hither stare, some provocative tail-whipping... My pets never fail to show me the same love I show them.

name.ja: とんずらドードー捕り物帖

defaultTalks: Slim diggings of late. I'd say we've mined her for all the ore she's got.
Luckily, Naldiq & Vymelli's has signed for the lot of it. Should make for some sturdy ships.

name.fr: Une quête qui sent le soufre

name.ja: コボルド族に気をつけろ！

defaultTalks: The Admiral herself has seen it fit to dub our stead an exemplary model of her settlement initiative.

As a Stead botanist, I attribute our success to unyielding innovation─our willingness to attempt any and all agricultural techniques at least once, no matter how counterintuitive or potentially embarrassing.

name.ja: 本草学者アレンロナの復讐
本草学者アレンロナの挑戦

defaultTalks: The dodos love the farm-fresh food so much, they're always pecking at the fences!
Sometimes they'll even peck themselves free and run about. I suppose the exercise is good for them, but it's certainly not what I need!

defaultTalks: Limsa Lominsa is not unique in her suffering; all the nations of Eorzea struggle with a multitude of hardships.
The difficulties of this age will not be surmounted without the aid of you and your fellow adventurers, thus I pray that your eagerness and compassion never wane.

name.ja: 海の都リムサ・ロミンサへ

defaultTalks: The Drowning Wench will always be a favorite among pirates─she's cheap, she's loaded with grog, and she never says no.
It's been a favored haunt of adventurers for nigh on twenty years, ever since a retired freelance and his comrades established the Adventurers' Guild here.
